channel.title: The Dig — Spin qubit devices and figures of merit
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Spin qubit devices and figures of merit preset. Today's ranked reading list covers a scalable silicon spin-qubit architecture with logical operations (2611.33590), a 2D FPGA Union-Find decoder without global coordination (2611.33665), reproducible energy-relaxation distributions from broadband SWAP spectroscopy (2611.33854), high-throughput GPU decoding of quantum bivariate bicycle codes (2611.34481), and experimental quantum hardware benchmarks of flat non-Clifford hypergraph states on IBM Heron r2 (2611.34683), with the first three skimmed for transferable ideas and the latter two most directly informing HPC-assisted QEC and calibration-aware benchmarking for a small spin-qubit machine.
